name: aajke-ki-scene
description: Aajke Ki Scene? — Banglish-first AI-assisted news, current affairs and exam prep.

scripts.db:migrate: uv run alembic -c apps/api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.lint: npm run lint:py && npm run lint --workspace apps/web
scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check apps/api apps/worker conftest.py scripts && uv run ruff format --check apps/api apps/worker conftest.py scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:py && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test --workspace apps/web
